description: This file is a React component for a web application that allows users to upload documents, generate a persona draft, view processing states, and manage profile data within a Career Navigator app. It includes functionality for file uploads, orchestration API calls, state management for different workflow steps, and UI rendering of progress indicators and forms.

methods.name: asStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown value into a string array if possible, filtering out empty strings.

methods.name: isNonEmptyObject
methods.description: Checks if a value is a non-null object with at least one key.

methods.name: getInitials
methods.description: Generates initials from a label string for avatar display.

methods.name: getNestedOrchestrationValue
methods.description: Safely accesses a nested value given a root object and a path array, returning value and found path.

methods.name: logAvailableKeys
methods.description: Logs the keys present at various levels within an orchestration object for debugging.

methods.name: extractPersonaJsonFromOrchestrationRecord
methods.description: Extracts the persona JSON object from orchestration response record by checking multiple candidate paths.

methods.name: coercePersonaDataFromBackendJson
methods.description: Maps backend persona JSON shapes into the UI's PersonaData format, handling legacy and newer structures.

methods.name: fingerprintPersonaData
methods.description: Creates a fingerprint string for a PersonaData object for change detection.

methods.name: fingerprintPersonaArtifact
methods.description: Creates a fingerprint string for a persona artifact JSON object for comparison.

methods.name: handleGenerateDraft
methods.description: Initiates document upload and orchestration to generate a persona draft.

methods.name: handleSaveChanges
methods.description: Saves the current persona data to the backend, updating existing persona.

methods.name: handleRegenerateDraft
methods.description: Re-generates a persona draft based on the current build status and personas.
